The '''Kuat Systems Transport II''' was a type of [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] manufactured by [[Kuat Systems Engineering/Legends|Kuat Systems Engineering]]. One such [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was the ''[[Porthoy]]''.
